news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹18.45 (down from ₹22.79 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹25.3b (up 4.5% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.03b (down 19% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (down from 15% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 4.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Commercial Services industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 1% per year.

news.title: CMS Info Systems Limited (NSEI:CMSINFO) announces an Equity Buyback for 4,939,126 shares, representing 3% for INR 1,679.3 million.
news.body: CMS Info Systems Limited (NSEI:CMSINFO) announces a share repurchase program. Under the program, the company will repurchase up to 4,939,126 shares, representing 3% for INR 1,679.3 million. The shares will be repurchased at a price of INR 340 per share. The Board has fixed Friday, May 22, 2026 as the record date. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 164,637,541  shares issued and outstanding.

news.title: CMSINFO: Dividend And Independent Director Appointment Will Support Future Upside
news.body: The analyst price target for CMS Info Systems is now ₹389, with analysts keeping key assumptions such as revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E essentially unchanged. This reflects a steady view on the company’s valuation drivers.

news.title: CMSINFO: Board Actions And Dividend Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target on CMS Info Systems steady at ₹389, reflecting unchanged assumptions on fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, with no new Street research driving a different view. What's in the News A board meeting will be held on February 12, 2026 to review the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, and to consider an interim dividend and a postal ballot notice for an independent director appointment (Key Developments).

news.title: CMSINFO: Long-Term SBI ATM Mandate Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for CMS Info Systems steady at ₹389, reflecting unchanged assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E for now. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for February 12, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, consider an interim dividend for FY 2025-26, and approve a postal ballot notice for an independent director appointment (company filing).

news.title: CMSINFO: SBI ATM Outsourcing Mandate Will Support Long-Term Upside
news.body: The analyst price target for CMS Info Systems has been revised from ₹432.20 to ₹389.00, with analysts citing a lower assumed future P/E multiple, while keeping long term growth and margin assumptions broadly unchanged. What's in the News CMS Info Systems received a ₹10,000m, 10 year contract from State Bank of India to manage 5,000 bank owned ATMs across India, covering managed services and cash efficiency initiatives starting January 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: CMSINFO: Long-Term SBI ATM Contract Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have revised their price target on CMS Info Systems from ₹466 to ₹432.20, reflecting updated assumptions around fair value, a slightly different discount rate, modestly adjusted revenue growth expectations, and a lower future P/E multiple, partly offset by a marginally higher profit margin outlook. What's in the News CMS Info Systems has been awarded a ₹10,000 million, 10-year contract from State Bank of India to manage 5,000 bank-owned ATMs across India, covering cash management, managed services and higher ATM uptime, with the contract going live in January 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.49 (vs ₹5.68 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.49 (down from ₹5.68 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.27b (up 7.8% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹574.0m (down 38% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.2% (down from 16% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 9.5% growth forecast for the Commercial Services industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 4% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 3% per year.
